title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/2397 of 26 October 2026 amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the leadership of the Transnistrian region of the Republic of Moldova

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union

sections.heading: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the leadership of the Transnistrian region of the Republic of Moldova

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Article 29 thereof,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 3
amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 4
amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 5

paras.text: On 27 September 2010, the Council adopted Decision 2010/573/CFSP ( 1 ) .
paras.loc: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 6
amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 7

paras.text: On the basis of a review of Decision 2010/573/CFSP, the restrictive measures set out therein should be extended until 31 October 2027.
paras.loc: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 8
amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 9

paras.text: Decision 2010/573/CFSP should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 10
amending Decision 2010/573/CFSP concerning restrictive measures against the lead, para 11

paras.text: In Article 4(2) of Decision 2010/573/CFSP, the date ‘31 October 2026’ is replaced by that of ‘31 October 2027’.
This Decision shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .

( 1 ) Council Decision 2010/573/CFSP of 27 September 2010 concerning restrictive measures against the leadership of the Transnistrian region of the Republic of Moldova ( OJ L 253, 28.9.2010, p. 54 , ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec/2010/573/oj ).
